evals.name: enumerate-keyword-endpoints
evals.prompt: What CADE API endpoints exist for keywords in prod? Give me a short list of method + path + one-line summary.
evals.expected_output: Uses list_endpoints.py with --filter keywords against env=prod. Summarizes the keyword-related endpoints (at minimum: GET list-by-domain, POST generate, GET single, PUT update, POST rejections, DELETE). Does NOT call any endpoint — this is enumeration only. Saves no file under .claude/cade-api-run/.

evals.name: health-check-prod
evals.prompt: Hit /system/health on prod via the CADE API and tell me what came back — especially the worker count and any active queues.
evals.expected_output: Runs `call_api.py GET /system/health` against env=prod (no --confirm needed since GET is a read). Reports the 2xx status + body, highlighting workers and queues. A run log file is written to .claude/cade-api-run/ with the {inputs, outputs} schema and the API key masked as ***.

evals.name: keyword-list-schema-lookup
evals.prompt: Looking at the CADE prod API, what does the response look like for GET /keywords/domain/{domain}? I want to know the schema so I know what fields to expect in the response body — but don't call the endpoint itself, just inspect the schema.
evals.expected_output: Uses list_endpoints.py --json /api/v1/keywords/domain/{domain} to dump the OpenAPI operation. Walks the response schema (likely DomainKeywordListResponse) and reports the shape: keywords array, pagination fields (total, page, page_size, total_pages), and the nested keyword item fields (id, keyword, search_intent, status, rejection_reason, supporting_keywords, relevant_questions). Does NOT call the live endpoint. Saves no file under .claude/cade-api-run/.
